t: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
d: Jamie cooks his incredible Avocado pastry quiche, with a delicious cheesy and basil filling, and shows us how to take a classic steak to the next level.

t: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day: Cheat's Fish and Chips  Sausage & Mash Pie
d: Jamie creates a sausage pie using golden mashed potatoes instead of pastry, and gives fish and chips a healthy makeover.

t: Jamie's Easy Meals For Every Day: Butter Chicken
d: Jamie rustles up a family-friendly version of a delicious butter chicken that even his little ones give the thumbs up to, and makes a super-simple salmon en croute.
Jamie cooks up a glorious mothership Roast Brisket of Beef with all the trimmings.
Jamie rustles up pork steaks, Hungarian pepper sauce and rice, plus killer kedgeree, beans, greens and chilli yogurt.

st: Rosemary Chicken and Happy Cow Burgers
d: Rosemary chicken  grilled polenta and porcini tomato sauce  happy cow burgers  old school coleslaw  corn on the cob.

st: Sticky Squid Balls and Sausage Fusilli
d: Jamie cooks sticky squid balls, grilled prawns and noodle broth, plus sausage fusilli and creamy garden salad.

st: 's 15 Minute Meals: Smoked Salmon and Greek Chicken
d: On the menu is smoked salmon, Yorkshire pudding, beets and asparagus, plus gorgeous Greek chicken, sweet pepper and pea couscous with tzatziki.
Sizzling chops  sweet tomato and asparagus lasagnetti  mushroom soup  Stilton  apple and walnut croutes.

st: 's 15 Minute Meals: Asian Tuna and Ricotta Fritters
d: Chef Jamie Oliver rustles up seared Asian tuna, coconut rice and greens, plus ricotta fritters, tomato sauce and zucchini salad.

st: Falafel Wraps and Spiced Chicken Lentils
d: This time the meal is spiced chicken, bacon, asparagus and spinach lentils  falafel wraps, grilled veg and salsa.
Jamie cooks grilled tuna, "kinda" Niçoise salad, Thai chicken laksa, and mildly-spiced noodle squash broth.

t: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food: Chicken Noodle Stir-fry  Pappa Al Pomodoro  Crispy Skin Lemon Sole  Honey Berry Filo Smash
d: Jamie makes a chicken noodle stir-fry, a hearty rustic tomato soup, pappa al pomodoro, honey berry filo smash and a crispy skin lemon sole.
Jamie rustles up a frugal, but amazing paella with succulent chicken thighs, spicy chorizo and prawns from the freezer  turning pork leftovers into crispy Mexican tacos and French Vietnamese banh mi.
